verdict.rationale: The pricing page lists "1-minute syncs", which shows sub-hour sync frequency. Connector docs list connection- and table-level re-syncs, a form of manual trigger, and the REST API supports programmatic pipeline management. Nothing documents a per-pipeline frequency setting or cron-based schedules; the only "set schedule" mention applies to transformations, not connector syncs. Missing for 10: documentation of per-connection sync frequency configuration, cron expression scheduling, an explicit on-demand 'sync now' trigger (UI or API), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
